round 6 follow-up, Fabio's screenshot: the review track was a flat fill. A take under review is not a file, so ffmpeg extractAudioWaveform cannot run and there is no mask to hand MpiWaveform. bakeWaveMask() now draws showwavespic shape in the renderer - mono, sqrt, white-on-transparent, same 1260x540 - applied after the player mounts and only if that instance is still the mounted one.

mask pixels measured: silence 0.002 of column height, loud 0.952, -30 dBFS 0.174 (linear would draw ~0.03 - that is what sqrt buys). Committed check: gallery-audio-waveform.spec.js "a take under review bakes its own waveform mask", passes 9.6s. npm test 1418/1419, 0 fail. Lint clean.

two from Fabio accepting a take: (1) PRE-EXISTING, folded in - mediaImportService._buildGroup dropped thumbPath on the AUDIO branch only, so every fresh audio card was blank until the project was reopened and the sidecar read back; (2) bakeWaveMask column is RMS now, not the bucket peak.

measured both bakes on voices/child_1.opus (mean ink / jaggedness): ffmpeg 0.173/0.021, ours by peak 0.289/0.037, ours by RMS 0.193/0.023 - the peak of 340 samples made neighbours disagree, which aliased into the smear Fabio called blurry. Spec threshold moved 0.8 -> 0.7 because a sine RMS is 1/sqrt(2) of peak, with the arithmetic stated. thumbPath test proven RED on un-fixed source. npm test 1419/1420, desktop spec green, lint clean.

ROUND 9c - CLASS B SWEPT (subject differs from container), and TWO OF ITS FOUR RECORDED ROWS WERE ALREADY CORRECT. That is the THIRD time this card's inherited survey has been wrong (after MpiMediaDropOverlay and the MpiEnhanceDialog.css CRLF phantom) - open the file before believing a survey row. MpiWaveform draws var(--accent-audio) DIRECTLY twice, which is right and deliberate: a waveform is permanently about audio so it must not inherit - do not "fix" it onto --accent-heat. MpiAudioPlayer draws no accent at all (--surface-viewer, --ink-1). The two real gaps are fixed: MpiVoicePicker takes data-accent="audio" (a voice is audio whatever the Flow makes, and MpiBaseFlow was accenting it orange inside a video Flow), and MpiMediaPicker sets el.dataset.accent from its EXISTING props.mediaType so picking a reference image for a video op reads as an image job. MpiMediaSlot left alone on purpose: no media-type prop, and threading one from two callers to colour a hover border is not worth it. eslint clean, no test added - same one-line attribute shape as navigation.js:297 and MpiBaseFlow.js:215, neither of which has one. NO EMITTER CHANGED. That is the FOURTH wrong inherited row on this card (after MpiMediaDropOverlay, the MpiEnhanceDialog.css CRLF phantom, and two of class B's four rows) - check a survey claim before budgeting for it. Built: getCommandAccent(key) in commandRegistry.js beside getCommandProgressLabel (op key -> mediaType -> accent, image->vision, unknown->studio); statusBar.js sets _fill.dataset.accent on tool:running and DELETES it on the way to idle, because .shell-info__fill is the only element in the bar drawing --accent-heat and idle is about no media type. Flows needed NO special case: the twelve flow* ops are ordinary registry rows carrying their own mediaType, so an LTX foley run reads audio and an outpaint reads image - measured 22 vision, 14 video, 5 audio, 2 studio (the cream two are createGroupFromSelection and promoteToNewGroup, correctly about no medium).
